description:
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Myth Unbound until end of turn.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Rograkh, adding {R}.
Choose to have Rograkh returned to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Mirage Mirror each trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to Myth Unbound and Mirage Mirror's cost reductions.
Repeat from step 2.
